live_evidence.producer: local run 2026-09-06 (full backend unit + full backend e2e + frontend e2e, with db:bootstrap:access-control restored)
live_evidence.scope_note: Full sweep: backend unit (19 cases), the COMPLETE backend e2e suite (43 files / 406 cases), and the frontend Playwright suite (124 cases) all executed at these SHAs. No suite was omitted.
live_evidence.integrity_caveat: Evidence was produced from a WORKING TREE that carries one uncommitted change: the restored "db:bootstrap:access-control" script in services/backend/package.json. recorded_source_sha therefore names a commit that does NOT yet contain the fix. A clean checkout of d8faa81f reproduces 37 acm1r-fr-foundation failures. Commit the fix before treating this run as reproducible evidence.

change_from_previous.note: Same verdict, materially different basis. The 2026-09-04b run computed CONCERNS while its own live evidence covered 148 cases and explicitly excluded the backend e2e suite. This run observed 549 cases with every suite executed. It also corrects a false green: the acm1r-fr-foundation suite was 37/39 RED on 2026-09-04b and was never observed, because db:bootstrap:access-control had been deleted from services/backend/package.json in commit 37a339a.
